summary: Luke Badiali met Joanna Pike and Oliver Grant to replace the spreadsheet tracker with a proper CRM and agree what the partners will review each month. We agreed on HubSpot Sales Professional and a monthly dashboard built on the five stages from Week 5. Forecasting retainers separately from project work was raised but not settled.

discussion.keyPoints: Joanna confirmed budget for licences. Oliver wanted something consultants would actually use and that tracks relationships with PE houses as well as portfolio companies.
Contacts sit in individual inboxes and the old tracker. Luke stressed that each opportunity must link to both the PE house and the portfolio company.
Joanna wants to see retainer income as recurring revenue. Oliver worried that splitting forecasts would add admin the consultants will resist.

recommendations.recommendation: Move to HubSpot Sales Professional with 6 paid seats for partners and senior consultants, live by the end of next month.
Require every opportunity to be linked to a PE house and a portfolio company record, with a monthly data hygiene check.
Forecast retainers as monthly recurring revenue separately from project fees.
Build a one-page partner dashboard covering pipeline by stage, win rate and retainer count, reviewed on the first Monday of each month.
Write a sales playbook in the CRM covering the four-touch sequence and the discovery guide.

actions.action: Set up HubSpot pipeline with the five agreed stages and import live opportunities

nextFocus: Align marketing campaigns and thought leadership with the operating partner narrative.
nextPreparation: Joanna to list any articles or talks she has done in the last year.

tests.question: Which CRM did we agree to move to and how many seats?
When will the partners review the dashboard?
